profile_text.body:
AI21 Labs is a for-profit AI startup founded in 2017 and headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel. The company describes itself as a builder of foundation models and AI systems for the enterprise, with a stated focus on powering critical enterprise workflows with what it characterizes as accurate, reliable, and scalable AI.

The company's tracked products include the AI21 Labs API, which surfaces its Jurassic models through an enterprise API with data retention controls and a compliance-focused design, and Wordtune, a writing and rewriting tool. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are held for the company at this time.
